subject: Hybrid exec day — seat map, mic inventory & failover plan
messages:
From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@venuehub.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: AV Support <av-support@venuehub.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec suite request — prelim capacity + network constraints

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the heads up about the June 29 exec day. Quick summary from our side after the site walk: main executive room seats 48 (the board layout), adjacent breakout can hold 12 theatre-style. The AV rack lives in the north closet (see attached preliminary floorplan).

Technical constraints we flagged:
- HDMI wall plates: 4 active inputs (two at dais, two at rear)
- SIP bridge requires a static public IP for stable media path; we can provide a managed SIP trunk but need the customer to allow outbound UDP 5060 and a small RTP range (audio 10 ports)
- Wired camera feed available via 10G uplink in equipment room (we can multicast to local encoder)
- Power at dais: 2 x 20A circuits; we recommend no more than 6 powered devices on dais to avoid tripping breakers

We attach the site plan and a first-pass checklist. We can supply onsite AV techs (4 hours prior to first session) and a backup PSTN audio path for the bridge.

Attachment: venue-prelim-floorplan.pdf

If you can confirm final headcount and whether you want lapel mics for every speaker or a shared handheld pool, we will produce a final mic inventory and SOW.

— Sophie
Sophie Li
Client Success / VenueHub
phone: +1 415-555-0198
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@venuehub.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec suite request — prelim capacity + network constraints

Thanks Sophie — helpful start. Two quick asks so we can lock headcount and AV qty: 

1) We expect 34 onsite execs in the main room (board layout) and ~9 staff in adjacent breakout for support and remote monitors. Please size mic inventory for 40 presenters to be safe (we will rotate).
2) Confirm you can provide 6 lavalier wireless + 2 handhelds and a mixer with 4 XLR returns. If not, list alternatives.

Additional requirements from our side:
- We will provide a dedicated VLAN for camera and bridging (will request static IP). Please confirm whether the SIP trunk needs NAT exemptions or a public IP assigned to your encoder.
- We need a recorded stereo feed (local recorder) and a low-latency stream to our SRE team.

Connor/Laura — can you confirm travel timing and whether we need two-stage rehearsals (AM mic check + afternoon dry run)? Tessa — final headcount due by Friday (6/18).

I attached Sophie's floorplan to this thread for internal reference.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Events & Executive Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec suite request — prelim capacity + network constraints

Eve — quick internal notes after reading Sophie's plan:
- I want dedicated lapels (not shared) for keynote + 3 breakout moderators. Shared handhelds ok for audience Q&A.
- Need chargers and spare batteries on site (min 6 spare AA/AAA + 4 spare lav batteries).
- Please ask vendor to confirm wattage draw for all powered units at the dais. Laura — can you confirm if the room has UPS coverage for the AV rack? If not, we should rent a small UPS to cover mixer + encoder for graceful failover.
- On rehearsal cadence: AM mic check + 90m technical review (camera framing, stream ingest) the day before; 60m dry run day-of in the morning.

I'll coordinate with SRE for static IP and provide firewall exceptions.

— Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@venuehub.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: AV Support <av-support@venuehub.io>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec suite request — prelim capacity + network constraints

On Wed, Jun 16, 2026 at 09:10 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Eve — quick internal notes after reading Sophie's plan:
> - I want dedicated lapels (not shared) for keynote + 3 breakout moderators. Shared handhelds ok for audience Q&A.

Thanks Connor — confirmed. Answers to your questions below: 
- We can supply 6 Sennheiser EW lapels (wireless) + 2 handheld shure SM58, with charging dock and 6 spare lav batteries.
- Mixer: Allen & Heath QU-16 with 4 XLR returns and redundant DI. Wattage draw for the dais stack (mixer + encoder + small amp + 2 powered monitors) is ~760W; that fits within the two 20A circuits if power is balanced.
- UPS: venue has no UPS in the rack; we offer a rented UPS (kVA rated) for the AV rack — recommend we add to SOW.
- Bridging/Failover: we provide two audio paths: primary SIP trunk (static IP required) + secondary PSTN trunk. We will also supply a local stereo recorder and 2-channel live stream encoder with 200ms end-to-end latency on the 10G uplink.
- On rehearsals: our tech will arrive 4 hours prior for setup and we recommend the AM mic check + full dry run 60–90 minutes before first session.

Attaching updated inventory (mic-and-amp-inventory.xlsx) and updated SOW draft.

Attachment: mic-and-amp-inventory.xlsx

If this looks good I'll produce a final seatmap (we can label mic positions and cable runs) and send a DocuSign link for the SOW.

— Sophie
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@venuehub.io>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 17:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: seatmap v3, mic counts and SOW signature request

Thanks everyone — this aligns with our needs. Final confirmations and action items below: 

Confirmed:
- Headcount: 34 execs main room, 9 breakout/staff; seatmap v3 attached with assigned speaker positions and three labeled audio zones.
- Mic inventory: 6 lavalier wireless (assigned), 2 handhelds (audience pool), 1 wired lectern mic as backup. Spare batteries & charging dock included.
- Bridging: primary SIP trunk (static IP provided by our network team) + PSTN backup. AV vendor to test both during rehearsal.
- Recording: local stereo recorder + stream to our SRE endpoint on the 10G uplink.
- UPS: include 1x 1kVA UPS on the AV rack in SOW.

Action items / owners:
- Tessa: final attendee list and name badges by EOD Mon 6/21.
- Connor: submit static IP & firewall rules to Sophie by 6/19.
- Sophie / VenueHub: update SOW and send DocuSign; include UPS rental line item and one onsite tech for 8 hours (4 setup + 4 event).
- Laura: confirm whether we need to ship any additional adapters (we have 2 spare HDMI to SDI converters in inventory).

Please find seatmap_v3.pdf attached for labeling and final review. Sophie — once DocuSign is sent, we will route through procurement for signature. Jordan — looping you for visibility from the Novus side; let us know if Novus wants a branded intro slide for the stream.

Thanks — see you at the rehearsal.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Events & Executive Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: hybrid-seatmap_v3.pdf
